create_blob_detector: create a BlobDetector instance with color ranges for YUV-based blob detection in camera images
detect_blobs_in_image: run the BlobDetector on an RGB image to find colored blobs and return their centers and contours
find_blob_by_color_range: find the largest blob matching a specific YUV color range in a preprocessed image
setup_mask_for_detection: setup an image mask to exclude specific regions from blob detection using mask points
create_range_trackbar: create a CreateRangeTrackbar for tuning U or V color threshold ranges in the OpenCV GUI toolkit
